# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_CONFIRMATION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An overnight gap down that fails to fill on weak up‑volume is likely to reverse, providing a short entry opportunity. This edge exists because weak buying interest on the gap-fill attempt indicates lack of conviction, making a reversal more probable than continuation.

## Mechanism

At 10:30 ET, check three conditions: (1) overnight gap down ≥0.5% (open vs prior close), (2) session high to date is below prior day's close (gap not filled), (3) volume of the 10:30 bar is less than the average volume of the preceding five 5‑min bars. If all true, enter short at the close of the 10:30 bar. Exit: chart‑stop at gap high (or prior close if higher), initial target at 1 R (risk = entry‑stop distance), runner trailed 10 % from highest close after entry.
